product_summary: Website (pheromonechemicals.com/products) lists a 260+ SKU portfolio of aroma chemicals, fragrance intermediates, surfactants and industrial fluids: phenylethyl acetate, styrallyl acetate/alcohol, para anisyl acetate/aldehyde/alcohol, terpineol & terpinyl acetate, geraniol, citronellol-type nitriles, eugenol/isoeugenol/methyl isoeugenol, benzyl benzoate, methyl/iso amyl/hexyl/cyclohexyl salicylates, cinnamic aldehyde, hexyl cinnamic aldehyde, lilial, D-carvone, menthol crystals, diphenyl oxide (incl. ESDS heat-transfer blends), diethyl phthalate, dioctyl adipate, polysorbates 20/60/80, LABSA, Rhodapex ESB 70RB C, coco MEA / coco amidopropyl betaine, GMS/EGMS, isopropyl myristate, white mineral oil and petroleum jelly, black pepper oil. Company describes itself as a sourcing/contract-manufacturing platform (est. 2016, Ahmedabad, Gujarat) working through HJ Arochem (12,000 MT capacity, Moraiya/Changodar) and US subsidiary Ringman LLC.

comment: Declared HS 2915.39 (acetic acid esters) is genuinely present in the portfolio — phenylethyl acetate, styrallyl acetate, para anisyl acetate, iso amyl acetate, eugenyl acetate, PTBCHA/OTBCHA, prenyl acetate — so the code is not wrong, but it covers only a small slice of the catalogue. Status: partial. The bulk of the range sits in other chapters: 2915.60/2915.90 (alcohols), 2916.31/2916.39 (benzoates and salicylates), 2912 (aldehydes), 2914 (ketones/eugenol), 2909 (ethers, diphenyl oxide), 2922 (anthranilate, amides), 2917 (phthalate/adipate), 3402 (surfactants, polysorbates, LABSA), 3823/3824 (stearates), 2710.19/3820 (heat transfer fluids, mineral oil, petroleum jelly), 3301.29 (essential oils). Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas) is a misclassification: this is a specialty/aroma-chemical and surfactant trader-manufacturer, not an oil & gas supplier; the only adjacent line is diphenyl-oxide heat transfer fluid. Trader signs: the site positions itself as a procurement/sourcing and contract-manufacturing platform, with manufacturing capacity attributed to affiliate HJ Arochem and warehousing to Ringman LLC (USA); no own plant is claimed. Product lines missing from the declaration: surfactants (LABSA, polysorbates, Rhodapex), stearates, phthalates/adipates, mineral oils/petroleum jelly, essential oils, heat transfer fluids. All product listings are catalogue claims only — no customs line was checked in this task, therefore every HS mapping above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Per project rule 3, no rejection on HS grounds; code should be corrected/expanded to the actual multi-chapter range.
